title: A nested include is expanded where its include statement appears
rule: A file included by an included file is applied at the position of its include statement, before the including file's own declarations.

provisional.question: Where do the declarations of a nested include land in the include order? node-lookml-parser places them after the including file's own declarations (m1 resolves b).

citations.quote: then file B will be included into file A before file A is imported into the current project.
LookML refinements leverage the order of includes
